objective: Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire wants you to bring him a bronze tube.

description: My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.
Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
progress: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
completion: This is perfect, <name>. The first step is complete!
